Hadoop & Enterprise Big Data Platform Administration

Enterprise Big Data administration across Hortonworks, Cloudera, Hadoop, Kafka, and Azure, with a focus on security, automation, platform modernization, and workload performance.

I administer and support enterprise Big Data platforms and distributed data-processing environments, with experience across Hortonworks, Cloudera, the Hadoop ecosystem, and streaming platforms such as Kafka.

My work covers platform configuration, cluster administration, security, patching, upgrades, migrations, workload optimization, and operational automation.

I also support Azure-based data platforms, helping maintain reliable data processing through resource administration, pipeline troubleshooting, and capacity management.

Core Areas of Experience

Area Technologies and responsibilities
Enterprise distributions Hortonworks Data Platform (HDP) and Cloudera Data Platform (CDP)
Distributed storage Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS)
Processing and data services Hive, Spark, and HBase
Streaming platforms Apache Kafka
Data movement Apache NiFi, ingestion, replication, and migration
Security Kerberos, Apache Ranger, HDFS ACLs, and HDFS encryption
Recovery and data protection HDFS snapshots and data replication
Automation and deployment Ansible and Git
Workload scheduling Control-M
Azure data services Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and Integration Runtime
Azure resource administration Resource Groups, Key Vault, and quota management

Hadoop Cluster Administration

I manage Hadoop environments throughout their operational lifecycle, supporting day-to-day administration alongside changes in platform capacity and business requirements.

My responsibilities include:

  • Configuring and administering enterprise Hadoop clusters.
  • Monitoring platform health and investigating operational issues.
  • Commissioning and decommissioning cluster nodes.
  • Using Ansible to automate node-management activities.
  • Planning capacity and supporting cluster scaling.
  • Managing data replication and coordinating maintenance activities.
  • Supporting reliable execution of enterprise data-processing workloads.

The focus is on keeping the platform manageable as its storage, processing, and operational requirements evolve.

Platform Security and Data Protection

I administer security controls across Hadoop environments, addressing authentication, authorization, data access, and recovery requirements.

Authentication and Access Control

  • Configured and maintained Kerberos-based cluster authentication.
  • Managed access policies using Apache Ranger.
  • Applied HDFS access control lists (ACLs) to manage permissions.
  • Supported security and compliance requirements through controlled access to platform resources.

Encryption, Snapshots, and Recovery Support

  • Implemented HDFS encryption to protect stored data.
  • Managed HDFS snapshots to support recovery requirements.
  • Supported data replication activities.
  • Maintained data-protection controls alongside cluster maintenance and operational changes.

Patching, Upgrades, and Platform Migration

I performed platform maintenance and modernization activities across Hortonworks and Cloudera environments.

HDP Maintenance

  • Applied HDP patches and supported cluster upgrades.
  • Coordinated node commissioning and decommissioning.
  • Supported capacity planning and cluster expansion.
  • Used automation to make recurring administration activities more consistent.

Migration from HDP to CDP

Participated in the migration of Hortonworks Data Platform environments to Cloudera Data Platform.

My responsibilities included platform administration and migration support, alongside the maintenance and scaling activities required across the cluster lifecycle.

The objective was to support platform modernization while maintaining operational continuity for enterprise data workloads.

Performance Optimization

I investigate long-running workloads and scheduled jobs to identify bottlenecks and improve execution efficiency.

My experience includes optimizing:

  • Hive workloads.
  • Spark processing jobs.
  • HBase workloads.
  • Control-M jobs and associated execution workflows.

The work focuses on workload performance, reliable completion, and reducing the operational impact of extended processing times.

Key Achievement: Control-M Job Optimization

I optimized a long-running Control-M job, reducing its execution time from 52 hours to 4.5 hours.

Measure Result
Execution time before optimization 52 hours
Execution time after optimization 4.5 hours
Time saved per execution 47.5 hours
Execution-time reduction Approximately 91%

This improvement substantially shortened the execution window for the specific job.

The reduction describes that workload’s before-and-after execution time; it is not a benchmark for every job or the entire Big Data platform.

Automation and Deployment

I use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and improve consistency across platform administration and deployment activities.

Code Deployment

  • Automated code deployments using Ansible and Git.
  • Supported repeatable deployment workflows.
  • Used version-controlled code and automation to streamline operational changes.

Cluster Operations

  • Automated node commissioning and decommissioning activities.
  • Applied Ansible-based workflows to recurring administration tasks.
  • Supported consistent execution across multiple cluster nodes.

Hive Storage Housekeeping

Automated the deletion of obsolete Hive tables to reclaim storage and align data retention with business requirements.

This reduced the need for repeated manual cleanup and helped keep storage consumption aligned with the required data lifecycle.

Data Ingestion, Replication, and Migration

I supported enterprise data movement using Apache NiFi, including:

  • Data ingestion.
  • Replication workflows.
  • Data migration activities.
  • Operational support for data movement between environments.

This work complemented cluster administration by supporting the flow of data into and across the platform.

My broader platform experience also includes Apache Kafka within enterprise streaming environments.

Azure Data Platform Administration

Alongside Hadoop administration, I provision and manage Azure resources used by enterprise data-processing platforms.

Resource Provisioning and Configuration

My experience includes:

  • Azure Resource Groups.
  • Azure Databricks (ADB).
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF).
  • Azure Key Vault.

The focus is on secure configuration, scalability, resource planning, and cost-aware operations.

Pipeline and Integration Troubleshooting

I monitor and troubleshoot Azure Data Factory processing issues, including:

  • Pipeline failures.
  • Integration Runtime (IR) issues.
  • Azure quota constraints.

These activities support operational continuity by addressing issues that interrupt or prevent scheduled data processing.

Professional Focus

I combine Big Data platform administration with security, automation, and workload optimization.

My focus is on keeping distributed data environments secure, scalable, and operationally reliable while simplifying maintenance and supporting platform modernization.

From Hadoop cluster operations to Azure pipeline troubleshooting, the goal is consistent: reduce operational friction and help enterprise data workloads complete reliably.
